suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-18 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. The cited systematic review and meta-analysis reported significantly increased odds of depression among patients with vitiligo without establishing onset order or direction. Require independently established vitiligo and a separately established depressive disorder; the cited systematic review and meta-analysis reported significantly increased odds of depression among patients with vitiligo without establishing onset order or direction. Preserve other dermatologic disease, autoimmune disease, thyroid disease, medications, substance use, psychosocial stressors, and other psychiatric illness as competing explanations. Do not infer a depressive disorder from skin-pigmentation-related distress, stigmatization, or impairment alone, and do not treat this population-level association as proof that vitiligo caused an individual's depressive disorder. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
